scenes.title: Greeting at the Farm
scenes.direction: Full figure opening the farm gate or taking a natural step. Yard, misty fields and farmhouse; clear spring morning. Keep a visible point of contact with the setting.

scenes.title: A Day at the Beach — Sunbathing
scenes.direction: Use beach-spec.json via prepare-beach: fresh generation from her own approved swimsuit base and Happy portrait. Eye-level full figure on a raised-back wooden lounger, character left of center, legs toward lower right; striped towel/parasol, flower and lemonade table, basket, shells and harbour bay. Tail behind her toward viewer-right, root/upper length hidden by body and cushion; a small visible section is optional.

scenes.title: The Confession (Kimono) — Flustered
scenes.direction: Frontal waist-up at the summer night festival. Floating Pond lanterns, stalls and soft fireworks. The pair uses the same pose, outfit, location, camera and lighting.

scenes.title: The Confession (Kimono) — Loving
scenes.direction: Expression edit of the frontal Flustered scene. Keep the composition and kimono fixed; change the face using this character's approved Loving portrait.

scenes.title: The Wedding — Tearful Joy
scenes.direction: Full figure facing the viewer at the aisle's end under Willowmere chapel's bell. Show the gown silhouette, flowers and tall windows in warm spring afternoon light.

scenes.title: Wedding Night — Seated — Flustered
scenes.direction: Seated at the bed's edge in the approved bridal nightwear. Front-facing, hands grounded on bedding or lap, warm bedside lamp on a spring night.

scenes.title: Wedding Night — Cropped Recline — Loving
scenes.direction: Supported on pillows, near-frontal upward gaze, vertically arranged body within the horizontal room, crop around upper thighs. Dim bedside light; retain bridal nightwear and accessories.

scenes.title: Pajamas by the Window — Loving
scenes.direction: Waist-up facing the viewer by a farmhouse window, armchair, cushions and bookshelf. Warm lamplight with winter snow outside.

scenes.title: Pajamas — Cropped Recline — Loving
scenes.direction: Supported on pillows, near-frontal upward gaze, vertically arranged body within the horizontal room, crop around upper thighs. Dim warm light and approved everyday pajamas. Use the wedding-night recline as a framing reference.
